- Breakout A/B/C (45m each) — need 1 owner per room, plus a facilitator to collect top-3 outputs
- Panel (40m) — external + 1 Redwood PM moderator

Logistics: Grand Hyatt is cc'd for AV / room set. They asked for final room names and A/V run times by Friday.

Attachments: veridian_day1_agenda_v3.pdf (agenda heatmap)

Deliverable timeline I propose:
- This week (by Fri EOD): owners confirmed; list of slide owners and pre-read owners
- Next Mon: speaker-pack.zip (templates + A/V notes) distributed to owners
- Tue/Wed: dry run invites for owners where applicable

Marissa — would you take point on the panel moderator?
Kim — can you help with breakout facilitation ownership mapping?
Mateo — can you confirm AV time windows with Grand Hyatt and whether we can get a mic check at 7:45am?

Thanks — keeping this tight will let us get slides and pre-reads in front of execs at least 48 hours in advance.

Best,
